def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.read_csv('data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Number_of_Reports_by_Type.csv', skiprows=1)
    df.columns = ['Year', 'Fraud', 'Identity Theft', 'Other']
    df = df.dropna(how='all')
    df = df[df['Year'] != 'Year']
    return df

operatorProperties.code:
def process(load_reports) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = load_reports.copy()
    
    # Remove the source row (where Year contains 'Source:')
    df = df[~df['Year'].str.contains('Source', na=False)]
    
    # Convert columns to numeric, removing commas
    df['Fraud'] = df['Fraud'].str.replace(',', '').astype(int)
    df['Identity Theft'] = df['Identity Theft'].str.replace(',', '').astype(int)
    df['Other'] = df['Other'].str.replace(',', '').astype(int)
    df['Year'] = df['Year'].astype(int)
    
    # Calculate total reports
    df['Total'] = df['Fraud'] + df['Identity Theft'] + df['Other']
    
    # Check if Other is more than half
    df['Other_More_Than_Half'] = df['Other'] > (df['Total'] / 2)
    
    return df

operators.customDisplayName: Convert numeric columns from string to int, calculate total reports, determine if 'Other' reports exceed 50% of total for each year 2001-2024
Check if any year between 2001-2024 had 'Other' reports more than half of total reports. Returns Yes or No.
